objective: Test the new guard and stage boundaries using fresh stdlib-only backend fixtures. Never mount or import real backend modules, numerical packages, original/model/account artifacts or live credentials.

scope.harness_imports: Future synthetic execution may import this stdlib harness only; the present checkpoint performs AST inspection without importing it.
scope.actual_sourcebook_constructor: The genuine SourceBook2446/503e contract remains unchanged. Small fixture tests may create an explicitly labelled injected SourceBook with object.__new__, their own held directory FD and exact tiny pins; this is not genuine source authentication or admission.
scope.fixture_namespace: Only NEW empty backend packages and backend.capacity_fixture modules; stub audit CLI for the stage-journey test. Fixture mount covers backend completely, excluding the image and repository backend.
scope.generated_code: Freeze exact code hashes on the proposed native Python version in a separate source-reviewed fixture-preparation step. No wildcard generated code, fallback source or profile exemption. Genuine call manifest remains absent.
scope.allowed_source_edits: Test fixtures only. Never monkeypatch or rewrite the harness or any original admission/financial source to get green.

source_review_findings_corrected: Initial private _capacity_steps could be called without proving guard installation/source authentication; final draft checks exact fence type/state/profile and first pinned finder before import, then preimport runtime plus unchanged invocation/runtime admission.

Initial effect-module check missed simple top-level functions and unregistered generated dataclass methods; final check blocks all function-code frames in the declared paper/broker/provider modules before either registration branch.

Exact unchanged daily_prefix compiles <pinned daily prefix>; it requires distinct producer-bound exact code fingerprints for BOTH the exec module wrapper and continuation.inputs, limited to their exact module/LOAD phase. A source-review follow-up caught the omitted wrapper; no runtime was run.
Failure slot now requires O_RDWR and forbids O_APPEND before installation; readonly/append refusal must precede any backend import.

The reserved guard slot occupies the sole fresh proof root; the draft requires exactly that slot and held-FD/path identity before creating its new workflow child. It does not call full audit(), whose empty-root execution path is forbidden.
Full cgroup/process metrics, bounded retained-array metadata, source bookends and fsynced small phase receipts were added. None have runtime acceptance yet.

proposed_runtime_NOT_admission.host: Spark1 only, after fresh independent host and image/resource review; no Spark2 or live-model/service operation
proposed_runtime_NOT_admission.transport: Explicit local Docker unix socket and --pull never; exact owned CID retained. No command or controller is supplied by this source-only plan.
proposed_runtime_NOT_admission.mounts: Small harness/test sources RO, tiny fixtures RO, sole NEW finite output RW. No repository backend, native NumPy/sklearn, models, original namespaces, accounts, .env, socket or credentials.
proposed_runtime_NOT_admission.owned_child_cleanup: Source-reviewed parent registry, bounded wait/terminate/kill/reap and durable status for every actual owned PID; no os._exit control is ever run in the test parent. Outer owned-container stop on timeout.
proposed_runtime_NOT_admission.metric_scope: The unchanged draft measurement() reads the actual proposed2GiB cgroup and process counters. No measurement monkeypatch or injected kernel-counter text. A small stdlib-only positive stage fixture is not a genuine loader/model capacity result. Wrong-limit refusal can be a separately named tiny child/container only after its concrete source/resources are reviewed.
